As informações só devem ser utilizadas para fins pessoais, associativos ou profissionais; estando excluída toda a utilização para fins comerciais ou publicitários.
why.basis: published terms page (Avisos legais), reproduction clause

interface: Decision lists on the website (HTML pages under /decisoes/: deliberacoes, autorizacoes, diretrizes, pareceres); no API or feed found.
notes: quote_lang is Portuguese (pt), not en. Aggregate-only fit: counts of decisions per month would be our own statistics, but the clause excludes commercial or advertising use, and PrompTugal plans revenue, so it RESTRICTS reuse of the text; counts and links may be fine, lead to ask CNPD. robots.txt returned 404 (no rule). Decisions can name organisations and people: link only, never copy text.
